rules.statement: A creditor must exhaust his legal remedies against the principal debtor for payment right up to the execution against his property before pursuing a surety.
rules.supporting_quote: It means that the creditor must exhaust his legal remedies against the principal debtor for payment right up to the execution against his property [See Grotious 3.3.27; Voet 46.1.14; Van Leeuwen CF 1.4.17.18; Hurley v. Marais (1883) 2 SC 155; Wolfson v. Crowe 1904 TS 682; Worthington v. Wilson 1918 TPD 104].
